ABSTRACT: A method for asymmetric propargylation and allenylation of
\beta , \gamma \mathrm { . }
unsaturated α-ketoesters catalyzed by Box-Cu/Box-Zn using a commercial organo-
boron reagent is reported. The reaction was demonstrated to be broadly tolerant of

experiments as well as the synthesis of various chiral tertiary alcohols and glycol
derivatives demonstrated the practicality of this synthetic strategy.
